description: Typecheck gate fails: `npx tsc --noEmit` reports 6 errors in src/test/sc1-project-setup.test.ts and src/test/sc2-tokens.test.ts — cannot find module 'node:fs' / 'node:path' and cannot find name '__dirname'. @types/node is not a devDependency and the tsconfig `types` array (['vitest/globals','@testing-library/jest-dom']) excludes node types. Because the build script is `tsc && vite build`, this breaks `npm run build`.
suggested_fix: Add `@types/node` to devDependencies and add "node" to compilerOptions.types in tsconfig.json (or rewrite the two tests to derive the root via `fileURLToPath(new URL('../..', import.meta.url))` instead of __dirname). Re-run `npx tsc --noEmit` until clean.

description: The `/` home route exists but nothing in the nav (nor the brand wordmark) links to it — only the four medium filters and the three pages are reachable. A visitor on an inner page has no way back to the main feed via the chrome.
suggested_fix: Link the Brand wordmark (Header.tsx) to `/` via a NavLink/Link, or add an explicit home entry. Keep it within the layout scope.

description: No ESLint config exists in the project, so the review's lint gate cannot run. Acceptable to defer for a static prototype, but noted so it's a conscious choice, not an oversight.
suggested_fix: Optionally add a flat eslint.config.js (typescript-eslint + react-hooks) in a later chore; not required for this subtask.
